description:
Create a new Meeting.

#### Uploading attachments
To upload attachments you must upload the entire payload as `multipart/form-data` content-type and
specify each parameter as form-data together with `attachments[]` as files.

schema.description: A Meeting within a Project, including its attendees, categories, and topics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Meeting. Use as the `{id}` path parameter to fetch, update, or delete the Meeting via `/rest/v1.0/meetings/{id}`.

position.description: Ordering of the Meeting within its series; lower values sort first.

created_by_id.description: Login Information (user) ID of the Meeting's creator. Only populated for meetings created after Dec 2023.

meeting_date.description: Calendar date the Meeting takes place.

occurred.description: Indicates whether this meeting has already taken place.

start_time.description: Free-text start time of the Meeting.

finish_time.description: Free-text finish time of the Meeting.

time_zone.description: IANA/Rails time zone the Meeting's times are expressed in.

is_private.description: When true, the Meeting is only visible to scheduled attendees and users with Admin access to the Meetings tool.

is_draft.description: When true, the Meeting is still a draft and not yet finalized.

mode.description: Whether the Meeting is currently in agenda or minutes mode. Constrained to the values in the enum.

remote_meeting_url.description: URL attendees can use to join the Meeting remotely. Null when no remote link is set.

meeting_template_id.description: Identifier of the Meeting Template this Meeting was created from. Null when the Meeting was not created from a template.

description.description: Plain-text overview of the Meeting, with any rich-text markup stripped.

conclusion.description: Plain-text conclusion of the Meeting, with any rich-text markup stripped.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the Meeting was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the Meeting was last updated.

download_all_url.description: URL to download all of the Meeting's attachments as a single archive. Only present when the Meeting has attachments.

url.description: Download URL for the attached file.

filename.description: Original file name of the attachment.

name.description: Display name of the attached file (same value as `filename`).

project_id.description: Identifier of the Project the Meeting belongs to.

meeting.description: Attributes for the Meeting to create.

position.description: Ordering of the Meeting within its series; lower values sort first.

meeting_date.description: Calendar date the Meeting takes place.

occurred.description: Whether the Meeting has already taken place.

start_time.description: Free-text start time of the Meeting.

finish_time.description: Free-text finish time of the Meeting.

time_zone.description: IANA/Rails time zone the Meeting's times are expressed in.

is_private.description: When true, restricts the Meeting to scheduled attendees and users with Admin access to the Meetings tool.

is_draft.description: When true, saves the Meeting as a draft rather than finalizing it.

attendees.description: Login Information (user) IDs of the Project users to add as attendees.

items.description: Login Information (user) ID of an attendee.

drawing_revision_ids.description: Drawing Revisions to attach to the response

file_version_ids.description: File Versions to attach to the response

form_ids.description: Forms to attach to the response

image_ids.description: Images to attach to the response

upload_ids.description: Uploads to attach to the response

document_management_document_revision_id.description: PDM document to attach to the response

attachments.description:
Meeting Attachments.
To upload attachments you must upload the entire payload as `multipart/form-data` content-type and
specify each parameter as form-data together with `attachments[]` as files.
